title: Runtime SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter for resolved creature geometry
description:
## Summary
Create a real runtime Unity `SkinnedMeshRenderer` adapter that installs already-authored binding data + the `CreatureRig` indexed bone hierarchy into Unity, producing the MVP's "generated creature rendered through a SkinnedMeshRenderer." This is the connective tissue that does not exist anywhere today.

## Scope
- A separate presentation adapter (NOT inside `CreatureRig`, NOT in the pure generation path). It consumes binding data (per-item weights from 0130/0131) + `CreatureRig`'s index-parallel `Transform[]` and builds once: `Mesh.boneWeights`/`BoneWeight` (cap 4, reuse `MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex`), `Mesh.bindposes` (full `Matrix4x4` inverse-rest-bone-in-mesh-local; bind==rest convention), and a `SkinnedMeshRenderer` with `.bones`/`.rootBone` from `CreatureRig`. Preserve submeshes/materials (MaterialRegion/ADR-009).
- Lock the shared `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` bone-index ordering invariant with 0130/0131; mesh-local==creature-space==rig-host-space at identity; mirrored bone handling via `SemanticBoneResolver`/`MirrorUtility`.
- `GeneratedCreature` stays pose-free; adapter is a pure data->Unity-Mesh converter (no re-derivation of weights/bindposes). Animation ticks only change bone Transform position/rotation; no mesh.SetVertices/RecalculateNormals/Bounds, no weight/bindpose/rebind rebuild per frame.
- Keep `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` as the cross-check oracle, not a per-frame runtime path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- SMR rest result == generated rest geometry within tolerance; one posed bone deforms expected vertices; posed->rest restores within tolerance.
- Posed SMR == `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` oracle within tolerance on the same real geometry (the test that proves Unity wiring, not just the math).
- Mirror: mirrored deformation == reflection of unmirrored via `MirrorUtility`.
- Renderer setup happens once; per-frame changes transforms only; no per-frame managed allocations or mesh rebuild (minimal zero-alloc ceiling embedded as acceptance).
- Ownership/lifecycle: rebuild/destroy/rebind leaves no orphaned generated objects; source mesh not modified.

## Validation
PLAY MODE REQUIRED (hard gate): `SkinnedMeshRenderer`/`Mesh.boneWeights`/`bindposes`/`bones`/`rootBone` are Engine types readable only in a running instance. Rest, posed, restore, mirror, and lifecycle tests in PlayMode on a real `GeneratedCreature`; plus dotnet builds and git diff --check. Cannot be marked Done without Unity validation.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): no live SkinnedMeshRenderer/boneWeights/bindposes/BoneWeight anywhere; CreatureRuntimePreview attaches static MeshFilter/MeshRenderer/MeshCollider per item, unrelated to CreatureRig. TSK-0077 satisfied only the LBS "documented equivalent" branch. Rig bones already exist as real GameObjects with cached index-parallel Transform[].

## Blockers
Unity execution required to close (PlayMode read-back). Consumes binding data from 0130/0131 and the indexed rig from TSK-0073/TSK-0118.

## Next Step
After 0133 driver-decision and TSK-0118 close; wire rigid items (0130 data) first, then implicit surface (0131 data). Parent TSK-0077 stays open until this lands (its tightened SMR-specific acceptance).
